task_instruction: Audit the attached markup (tools/bench-agent-cost/fixtures/design_target.html) for WCAG 2.2 AA violations and Nielsen heuristic issues, per this repo's agents/ux-designer.md / skills/design/design.md procedure. For each violation: cite the exact element, name the specific WCAG success criterion (or Nielsen heuristic) violated, state its severity, and propose the minimal fix. Do not edit the file yourself -- produce an audit report only.
completion_threshold_rationale: Pre-registered before any run of this task exists (Fisher discipline; corrects the retrospective labeling error PR #122 had to walk back for review_small_diff -- this task's threshold is fixed and committed before its first run, per tools/bench-agent-cost/README.md's go-forward rule). Chosen at 5/10: the two highest-weighted criteria (placeholder_as_label 3pts + color_only_indicator 2pts) sum to exactly this value, so a run must catch at least the two most severe, most textbook-canonical violations to count as having completed the audit rather than merely attempted it -- the same logic review_small_diff's rationale applies (summed against whichever criteria a run actually hits, not only this named combination).

rubric.criterion: Identifies the email input's placeholder-as-only-label as a WCAG 3.3.2 violation (Labels or Instructions) and recommends a persistent <label> element.
Identifies the red-text-only error status as a WCAG 1.4.1 violation (Use of Color) and recommends pairing with an icon or text label.
Identifies the clickable <div onclick> as not keyboard-reachable / lacking a visible focus indicator (WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard and/or 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured) and recommends a native <button> element.
Identifies the 16x16px icon button as failing the WCAG 2.2 AA minimum target size (2.5.8 Target Size Minimum, 24x24 CSS px) and recommends increasing it.
Reports no violation that is not actually present in the fixture (no false positives).
